INSIGHTS.DESCRIPTION: Build your own reports by market, team, category and agent. You only see figures for conversations you're allowed to see.
INSIGHTS.API_ERROR: Something went wrong. Please try again.

INDEX.NO_DASHBOARDS: No dashboards yet. Make one to keep the figures you check most in one place.
INDEX.NO_SAVED_REPORTS: No saved reports yet. Build a report and save it to find it here.
INDEX.NO_SNAPSHOTS: No snapshots yet. Take one from a report to keep its figures as they are now.

BUILDER.BUSINESS_HOURS_HELP: Count response and resolution times in each inbox's business hours.
BUILDER.SNAPSHOT_TAKEN: Snapshot taken. Find it under Insights.

SAVE_DIALOG.TITLE: Save report
SAVE_DIALOG.DESCRIPTION: Saved reports keep their period as a name, so “Last month” always shows the month before you open it.
SAVE_DIALOG.NAME: Name
SAVE_DIALOG.NAME_PLACEHOLDER: e.g. Monthly by market and category
SAVE_DIALOG.SHARED: Share with everyone in the account
SAVE_DIALOG.SHARED_HELP: Each person sees only the figures they're allowed to see.

SNAPSHOT_DIALOG.TITLE: Take snapshot
SNAPSHOT_DIALOG.DESCRIPTION: A snapshot keeps today's figures for this report. They won't change when conversations are moved to another market, team or category. Only you can see it.
SNAPSHOT_DIALOG.NAME: Name

RESULTS.TRUNCATED: Showing the first 1,000 rows. Add filters to narrow the report.
RESULTS.CHART_LIMIT: The chart shows the first {n} rows.
RESULTS.DRILL: See the conversations behind this figure

DASHBOARD.DIALOG_DESCRIPTION: A dashboard shows widgets from your saved reports and refreshes on its own.
DASHBOARD.NAME: Name
DASHBOARD.SHARE_HELP: Everyone sees only the figures they're allowed to see.
DASHBOARD.WIDGET_DESCRIPTION: Widgets show a figure from one of your saved reports. Build and save a report first to use it here.
DASHBOARD.NO_REPORTS: You have no saved reports yet. Build one in Insights and save it first.
DASHBOARD.EMPTY: This dashboard has no widgets yet.
DASHBOARD.EMPTY_EDITABLE: Add a widget to start. Each one shows a figure from a saved report.

SCHEDULE.TITLE: Email this report
SCHEDULE.DESCRIPTION: Send this report by email on a schedule, with the files attached. Each person gets the figures they're allowed to see.
SCHEDULE.SENDING: Sending now. It should arrive in a minute or two.
SCHEDULE.RECIPIENTS_HELP: Sending to others needs the report to be shared, so they can open it.
SCHEDULE.ONLY_YOU: This report will be emailed to you.
SCHEDULE.PERIOD_HINT: Each email covers the report's period, worked out on the day it's sent. For a weekly email, save the report with “Last week”.

EXPORT.ERROR: The file couldn't be made. Please try again.

SNAPSHOT.NOTICE: Snapshot taken {time}. These figures are frozen and won't change.

METRIC_HINTS.OPEN: Not resolved at the end of the period.
METRIC_HINTS.REOPENED: Conversations opened again after being resolved.
METRIC_HINTS.FIRST_RESPONSE_SLA: Share of first responses within the SLA target.
METRIC_HINTS.RESOLUTION_SLA: Share of resolutions within the SLA target.
